posts.title: A 64-bit RISC OS is coming – take a deep dive into it with ROUGOL
posts.description: The RISC OS London Show took place only a few weeks ago, and the big news that came from it was that not only had work been started on a 64-bit version of RISC OS, but that it was already at a point where it could be demonstrated.
